title: Distress call
base_prompt:
Fully animated cinematic stylized-realistic 3D CGI feature-film shot, continuous motion, expressive character animation and acting, believable fur and cloth simulation, detailed wet stone and metal, dynamic ocean, rain, spray, steam and sparks, cinematic lighting, anamorphic 16:9 widescreen, 24 fps.
Setting: the lighthouse keeper's room: curved stone walls, an old radio set, a desk with a corroded brass chart case, oil lamps and nautical charts. Time and weather: stormy overcast day returning, cold slate-blue and grey palette, gusting wind and rain, an eerie emerald glow from the sea.
Characters (keep exactly on-model): Penny, a fourteen-year-old girl with windblown auburn curls under a patterned headscarf, freckles, a heavy canvas mechanic's apron full of wrenches, pliers and gears, and a grease-stained linen rag; clever, practical, young-looking; a small battered red-and-white fishing boat with a lit wheelhouse, tossing on the waves.
Camera: push-in on the crackling radio set with Penny rushing in; one continuous shot, no cuts.
Action: The old radio set in the keeper's room crackles to life with a distress call; Penny rushes in and grabs the handset. Through the rain-streaked window a tiny fishing boat tosses on the waves far beyond the reef.
No dialogue.
Sound: radio static, garbled distress call, rain on glass, waves.
Audio: realistic sound effects and ambience only; spoken dialogue only as written above; no background music; no narrator.
extension_prompt:
Continue this exact shot seamlessly with the same camera move, the same characters (Penny, the fishing boat), identical costumes and props, the same setting, lighting and weather.
Action: Penny presses the handset to her ear, listening intently.
No dialogue.
Sound continues: radio static, garbled distress call, rain on glass, waves.
Audio: realistic sound effects and ambience only; spoken dialogue only as written above; no background music; no narrator.
